stories.title: NFL referee faces 112-mile dash on double-duty Sunday after FAA ground stop
summary: Don Willard faces 112-mile trip between NFL gamesNBA scrambles to replace referees stranded by delaysCollege football games postponed as teams struggleAn NFL official will work two games on the same day Sunday after the Federal Aviation Administration grounded all flights nationwide for several hours Friday, disrupting travel plans for professional and college teams across the country.Don Willard will officiate the Miami Dolphins’ game against the Indianapolis Colts at 1pm ET before traveling 112 miles east to work the Pittsburgh Steelers’ Sunday Night Football matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals.

stories.title: Here Manchester United go again, taking the Two Ronnies route to hiring a new boss | Jonathan Wilson
summary: Magnusson: What’s the name of the directory that lists members of the peerage?

Smithers: One’s a trade union leader, the other’s a member of the Cabinet …One of the Two Ronnies’ most celebrated sketches involves a Mastermind contestant whose specialist subject is answering the previous question.

History repeats itself: the first time as comedy, the second time as Manchester United, who seem continually to be answering not the question of who would be the best available manager now, but who might have been the best available manager a few years ago.
